name: dsh-yanyan-plugin-aux
description: Yanyan helpers for DeepSeek Harness: per-turn context watermark readings (optionally scoped to specific sessions), a tiered reminder ladder plus an independent long-term-memory tier (each tier is turned off by setting its percentage to 0; the three ladder tiers each carry a write-handover checkbox that only controls whether that tier writes or updates the shared handover file), a periodic clock line, and scheduled session-rotation reminders.

scripts.test: node test/settings.test.mjs && node test/rotate-schedule.test.mjs && node test/handover.test.mjs
